title: Sidebar
lead: A sidebar, typically used with Nav children

prose.text:
Sidebar is a Box with the following properties preset. You can customize it using the properties available in Box.

- pad: `"small"`
- gap: `"large"`
- height: `"min: '100%'"`

prose.title: React/DOM Properties
prose.text:
At its core, the Sidebar component is a regular <div> element. Thus, both DOM and React properties, methods, and events are accessible. To read up on all of the possible DOM attributes and types available for div elements, check out this [MDN Web Documents page.](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/div) To learn more about DOM events and methods, you can read more on the [MDN Web Events documentation page](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Events).

Also, feel free to read about the [types of React events available](https://reactjs.org/docs/handling-events.html), or see [how DOM attributes change in React.](https://reactjs.org/docs/dom-elements.html) Working in tandem with Styled Components, you also have access to the [as property.](https://styled-components.com/docs/api#as-polymorphic-prop)
